Q-MMR：离策略评估通过: Off-Policy Evaluation via
递归重新加权和矩匹配Recursive Reweighting and Moment Matching

Xiang Li
Nanjing University
lllllimited306@gmail.com
&Nan Jiang
UIUC
nanjiang@illinois.edu
摘要Abstract

我们提出了一个新颖的理论框架，We present a novel theoretical framework,Q-MMR，用于有限范围 MDP 中的离策略评估。, for off-policy evaluation in finite-horizon MDPs.Q-MMR学习一组标量权重，每个数据点一个，以便重新加权的奖励接近目标策略下的预期回报。通过针对价值函数鉴别器类的矩匹配目标，以自上而下的方式归纳学习权重。值得注意的是，也许令人惊讶的是，仅在可实现性下才能建立通用函数逼近的数据依赖的有限样本保证learns a set of scalar weights, one for each data point, such that the reweighted rewards approximate the expected return under the target policy. The weights are learned inductively in a top-down manner via a moment matching objective against a value-function discriminator class. Notably, and perhaps surprisingly, a data-dependent finite-sample guarantee for general function approximation can be established under only the realizability ofQπQ^{\pi}，有一个, with a无量纲dimension-free界限——也就是说，错误确实bound—that is, the error does不not取决于函数类的统计复杂性。我们还建立了与几种现有方法的联系，例如重要性抽样和 线性 FQE。进一步的理论分析为覆盖的本质提供了新的视角，这是一个对于离线强化学习至关重要的概念。depend on the statistical complexity of the function class. We also establish connections to several existing methods, such as importance sampling and linear FQE. Further theoretical analyses shed new light on the nature of coverage, a concept of fundamental importance to offline RL.

1 简介Introduction

使用价值函数近似的离策略评估（OPE）是强化学习（RL）理论中的基本和核心问题。在此任务中，人们估计目标政策的预期回报Off-policy evaluation (OPE) using value-function approximation is a fundamental and core problem in the theory of reinforcement learning (RL). In this task, one estimates the expected return of a target policyπ\pi通过利用函数类，使用从某些行为策略收集的数据using data collected from some behavior policy, by leveraging a function classℱ\mathcal{F}捕获目标策略的 Q 值函数that captures the target policy’s Q-value functionQπQ^{\pi}。对于一般函数逼近，规范方法是 Fitted-Q 评估 (FQE)，它解决了一系列最小二乘回归问题. For general function approximation, the canonical approach is Fitted-Q Evaluation (FQE), which solves a sequence of least-square regression problems(Ernst et al., 2005; Chen and Jiang, 2019; Le et al., 2019)。 FQE 也可以被视为 TD 算法的理论原型，TD 算法是 RL 的基础构建块。. FQE can also be viewed as the theoretical prototype of the TD algorithm, which is a foundational building block of RL.

虽然具有一般值函数近似的 OPE 理论在很大程度上被认为是一个成熟的领域，其中 FQE 和相关算法的有限样本保证已经建立While the theory of OPE with general value-function approximation is largely considered a mature area, where finite-sample guarantees for FQE and related algorithms have been established(Jiang and Xie, 2025)，我们的理解仍然存在显着差距：, there are still notable gaps in our understanding:

  • •

    尺寸依赖性。Dimension dependence.通用函数近似 (GFA) 下的所有现有分析都需要将经验损失转化为其总体对应物，在此期间需要支付函数类的统计维度（例如，All existing analyses under general function approximation (GFA) need to translate the empirical loss to its population counterpart, during which one pays for the statistical dimension of the function class (e.g.,log⁡|ℱ|\log|\mathcal{F}|对于有限的for finiteℱ\mathcal{F}或连续类的日志覆盖数）。虽然这种依赖性被广泛接受，但显然在某些情况下这种依赖性是宽松的：例如，当数据符合策略时，蒙特卡洛（MC）估计提供了直接的保证，而没有任何or the log covering number for continuous classes). While this dependence is widely accepted, there are clearly situations where this is loose: for example, when the data is on-policy, Monte-Carlo (MC) estimate provides straightforward guarantees without anylog⁡|ℱ|\log|\mathcal{F}|依赖性，提出了维度依赖性是真实的还是算法设计或其分析的产物的问题。dependence, raising the question of whether the dimension dependence is real or an artifact of the algorithm design or its analysis.

  • •

    一般分析和线性分析之间不一致。Inconsistency between the general and the linear analyses.除了 GFA 下的分析之外，研究人员还在线性和表格设置中获得了精致、尖锐（即通常是极小极大最优）的保证Apart from the analyses under GFA, researchers have also obtained refined, sharp (i.e., often minimax optimal) guarantees in the linear and the tabular settings(Duan et al., 2020; Yin and Wang, 2021)。事实证明，主要. As it turns out, the main1/n1/\sqrt{n}这些保证中的条款确实是无量纲的。此外，线性分析在比 GFA 分析中广泛采用的贝尔曼完整性假设更弱的条件下成立。事实上，不仅线性分析不能通过专门针对线性类的 GFA 分析来获得，它们还会产生新的概念，例如看似非常规的覆盖概念（参见第 1 节）。terms in these guarantees are indeed dimension-free. Moreover, the linear analyses hold under strictly weaker conditions than the Bellman-completeness assumption widely adopted in the GFA analyses. In fact, not only the linear analyses cannot be obtained by specializing the GFA analyses to the linear classes, they also give rise to novel concepts—such as seemingly unconventional notions of coverage (see Section4）——在总建筑面积分析中找不到这些内容。)—that are nowhere to be found in the GFA analyses.

无维度和“所见即所得”Dimension-freeness and “WYSIWYG”

一般函数逼近下离线强化学习中的标准 OPE 分析需要将经验损失转化为其群体对应物，在此期间需要付出函数类的统计维度的代价。相反，我们的分析仅集中于Standard OPE analyses in offline RL under general function approximation need to translate the empirical loss to its population counterpart, during which one pays for the statistical dimension of the function class. In contrast, our analysis only performs concentration onQπQ^{\pi}（等式。（(Eq.(3）），并且没有集中精力)), and no concentration onℱ\mathcal{F}是需要的，从而产生无量纲边界。 此外，经验匹配损失is needed, resulting in a dimension-free bound. In addition, the empirical matching lossℒ^\widehat{\mathcal{L}}在算法中观察到（方程（observed in the algorithm (Eq.(1)) 出现在界限中，这使得定理)) shows up in the bound, which makes Theorem1“所见即所得（WYSIWYG）”。一个缺点是很难判断匹配损失何时大或小；正如我们将在下面看到的，在特殊情况下，例如线性“what you see is what you get (WYSIWYG)”. One downside is that it can be difficult to tell when the matching loss will be large vs. small; as we will see below, in special cases like linearℱ\mathcal{F}，有温和的充分条件（即可逆样本协方差矩阵）保证, there are mild sufficient conditions (i.e., invertible sample covariance matrix) which guarantee that0匹配损失是可以实现的matching loss is achievable（提案(Propositions2和and3).

5 其他相关作品Other Related Works

在整篇论文中，我们讨论了与 FQE 的联系和比较。这里我们讨论其他几种相关方法。Throughout the paper we have discussed the connection and comparison to FQE. Here we discuss several other related methods.

边缘化重要性抽样（MIS）Marginalized Importance Sampling (MIS)

6 局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Work

我们通过讨论局限性和未来的工作来总结本文。一个主要限制是我们需要独立同分布。 轨迹数据；自适应收集的数据集将打破之间的条件独立性We conclude the paper by discussing limitations and future work. One major limitation is that we need i.i.d. trajectory data; an adaptively collected dataset will break the conditional independence betweenw^h(i)\widehat{w}_{h}^{(i)}和andsh+1(i)|sh(i),ah(i)s_{h+1}^{(i)}|s_{h}^{(i)},a_{h}^{(i)}。将我们的结果直接扩展到无限范围贴现情况将导致类似的困难。一个潜在的解决方案是利用以下事实：. A straightforward extension of our results to the infinite-horizon discounted case will result in similar difficulties. One potential solution is to leverage the fact thatw^h[n]\widehat{w}_{h}^{[n]}总是在于always lies inℱ¯h\overline{\mathcal{F}}_{h}（命题(Proposition4），这样我们就可以联合绑定), so we can union bound overℱ¯\overline{\mathcal{F}}。然而，这样做会带来首项的尺寸依赖性，我们希望将来通过更先进的集中工具来解决这个问题。. However, doing so will incur the dimension dependence in the leading term, and we hope to resolve this issue in the future with more advanced concentration tools.

C.5 命题证明Proofs of Proposition9和推论and Corollary10

MIS 方法通常采用类似于我们的极小极大形式MIS methods often take a minimax form similar to ourQ-MMR，在这里我们进一步讨论 MIS 中学习非参数权重的问题。采取 MQL, and here we provide further discussion on the issue with learning non-parametric weights in MIS. Taking MQL[Uehara et al., 2020]例如，其人口损失为（在无限范围贴现设置下）as an example, whose population loss is (in the infinite-horizon discounted setting)

(This issue can be viewed as a version of the infamous double-sampling problem.) In contrast, our algorithm and analyses forbid the choice ofww依赖于下一状态的随机性，这就避免了这个问题。现在，MQL 学习to depend on the next-state randomness, which avoids this problem.
